INTRIGUING.Definition: very interesting because it is unusual

POLITICALLY CORRECT.Definition: careful to avoid offending particular groups of people

THE MASSES.Definition: ordinary people; most of the population

LITERACY.Definition: the ability to read and write

STABILISE.Definition: make firm and unlikely to change

ANOMALIES.Definition: things that are different from what is normal or expected

SET THINGS STRAIGHT.Definition: put things right; correct what was wrong

EXCEPTIONS.Definition: cases that do not follow the usual rule

CONVOLUTED.Definition: very complicated and difficult to follow

ORGANISM.Definition: a single living thing, such as a plant or animal

RIVALRY.Definition: competition and bad feeling between two sides

HARMLESS.Definition: not dangerous or likely to hurt anyone

TRACING.Definition: searching back through history to find

UNAPPRECIATED.Definition: not valued or thanked by others

EXTENSIVE.Definition: large, with a lot of food

HIGHLIGHTED.Definition: marked so that they stand out

FROM SCRATCH.Definition: from the very beginning, with nothing to build on
